Find your pathway to get involved

Whether you are a student eager to speak, an educator looking to empower your school, or an experienced debater ready to coach, there is a structured place for you on the circuit.

Student Pathway

For Student Founders

You do not need prior speech & debate experience. We supply the curriculum slide decks, practice scrimmage partners, and faculty advisor pitch kits.

Start a Chapter at Your School
Academic Pathway

For Educators & Schools

Enrich your school academic offering with forensics. We take care of lesson planning, coach workshops, and inter-school practice pairings.

Sponsor a School Club
Mentorship Pathway

For Judges & Alumni Coaches

Give back to the circuit by adjudicating weekend novice scrimmage rounds and leading masterclasses in case analysis and public speaking.
